long_description:
Sign up for this Yoga with Puppies class at Smitten Kitten Beauty in Cheshire. This class will be led by Jillian - an experienced Yoga instructor, creating a fun, welcoming experience for all levels.

Tickets are $45 a person and a portion of the proceeds will benefit Dog Star Rescue. This event will sell out so make sure to buy your tickets well in advance.

Looking to adopt? View all adoptable dogs: https://dogstarrescue.org/adoptable-dogs-in-connecticut/
